"import cadquery as cq

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Open orthogonal line chain — 2D sketch on the YZ plane (mm)
# Local sketch coords (u, v) map to global (x, y, z) = (0, u, v)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Named YZ plane: origin (0,0,0), xDir = +Y, normal = +X  =>  local v -> +Z
P = cq.Plane.named("YZ")

# Chain vertices in LOCAL sketch coordinates (mm), in order:
pts_local = [
    (-8, -12),   # start of segment 1 (open end)
    (21, -12),   # end 1 / start 2
    (21, 5),     # end 2 / start 3
    (9, 5),      # end 3 / start 4
    (9, 26),     # end 4 / start 5
    (31, 26),    # end 5 / start 6
    (31, 44),    # end 6 / start 7
    (-3, 44),    # end of segment 7 (open end)
]

# Convert all sketch points to world coordinates exactly
pts_world = [P.toWorldCoords((u, v)) for (u, v) in pts_local]

# Build exactly the 7 required line entities (consecutive, coincident endpoints)
edges = [
    cq.Edge.makeLine(pts_world[i], pts_world[i + 1])
    for i in range(7)
]

# --- Deterministic sanity checks (no randomness) ---
assert len(edges) == 7, "Must be exactly 7 curve entities"

# All entities coplanar on YZ plane (global X == 0 for both endpoints of every edge)
for e in edges:
    for pt in (e.startPoint(), e.endPoint()):
        assert abs(pt.x) < 1e-9, f"Point off YZ plane: {pt.toTuple()}"

# Consecutive segments share truly coincident endpoints
for i in range(6):
    d = (edges[i].endPoint() - edges[i + 1].startPoint()).Length
    assert d < 1e-9, f"Segments {i+1} and {i+2} not coincident (gap {d})"

# Chain is open: start of first segment != end of last segment
gap = (edges[0].startPoint() - edges[-1].endPoint()).Length
assert gap > 1e-6, f"Chain unexpectedly closed (gap {gap})"

# Export exactly the 7 edges as a compound to sketch.step in the current directory
cq.exporters.export(cq.Compound.makeCompound(edges), "sketch.step")"
